thread.subject: [PATCH v3 0/7] gpio: rtd1625: minor cleanups and log improvements

20260816-gpio-cleanup-v3-0-f298cdd65fca@.subject: [PATCH v3 0/7] gpio: rtd1625: minor cleanups and log improvements

blocks.text:
This series splits the previous cleanup patch into smaller, logical 
pieces and addresses the review comments from Andy Shevchenko.

20260816-gpio-cleanup-v3-2-f298cdd65fca@.subject: [PATCH v3 2/7] gpio: rtd1625: Drop unneeded initializations

blocks.text:
Drop unneeded assignments. While at it, place correctly the comment to be
just above the referenced code.

Suggested-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Yu-Chun Lin <eleanor.lin@realtek.com>

20260816-gpio-cleanup-v3-5-f298cdd65fca@.subject: [PATCH v3 5/7] gpio: rtd1625: Narrow 'hwirq' variable scope in loop

blocks.text:
Declare 'hwirq' within the inner block where it's used to reduce variable
visibility.

Suggested-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Yu-Chun Lin <eleanor.lin@realtek.com>

20260816-gpio-cleanup-v3-6-f298cdd65fca@.subject: [PATCH v3 6/7] gpio: rtd1625: Replace pr_err_ratelimited() with dev_err_ratelimited()

blocks.text:
Using dev_* logging macros is preferred over pr_* in device drivers as it
provides proper device context in the kernel log output.

Suggested-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Yu-Chun Lin <eleanor.lin@realtek.com>

20260816-gpio-cleanup-v3-7-f298cdd65fca@.subject: [PATCH v3 7/7] gpio: rtd1625: Use IRQ_TYPE_DEFAULT macro

blocks.text:
Use the standard IRQ_TYPE_DEFAULT macro instead of explicitly listing all
supported edge and level IRQ type flags.

Suggested-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Yu-Chun Lin <eleanor.lin@realtek.com>
